variables.name: Department
variables.input:
timeseries v = max(m365copilot.user_licensed), by:{department}, from: now()-2d
| fields department
| sort department asc

0.content:
# 🤖 Copilot Corporate Stats
*Microsoft 365 Copilot adoption, usage, licence cost and estimated value — collected daily from Microsoft Graph. Per-user figures cover the trailing 28d.*

1.content:
## 📈 Adoption Overview
*Assigned licences reconciled against prompt activity in the last 28d. **Assigned = Active + Unused.***

2.query:
timeseries v = sum(m365copilot.licences.assigned), from: now()-2d
| fieldsAdd Assigned = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(v))
| filterOut isNull(Assigned)
| fields Assigned

4.query:
timeseries lic = max(m365copilot.user_licensed), by:{upn, user, department, account_enabled}, from: now()-2d
| fieldsAdd upn = lower(upn), licensed = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(lic))
| filterOut isNull(licensed)
| dedup upn
| lookup [
    timeseries p = max(m365copilot.user_prompts), by:{upn}, from: now()-3d
    | fieldsAdd upn = lower(upn), prompts = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(p))
    | summarize prompts = max(prompts), by:{upn}
  ], sourceField:upn, lookupField:upn, prefix:"u."
| fieldsAdd prompts = u.prompts
| fieldsAdd status = if(account_enabled == "false", "Disabled account", else: if(isNull(prompts), "No usage record", else: if(prompts == 0, "Zero prompts", else: "Prompting")))
| summarize Active = countIf(status == "Prompting")

6.query:
timeseries lic = max(m365copilot.user_licensed), by:{upn, user, department, account_enabled}, from: now()-2d
| fieldsAdd upn = lower(upn), licensed = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(lic))
| filterOut isNull(licensed)
| dedup upn
| lookup [
    timeseries p = max(m365copilot.user_prompts), by:{upn}, from: now()-3d
    | fieldsAdd upn = lower(upn), prompts = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(p))
    | summarize prompts = max(prompts), by:{upn}
  ], sourceField:upn, lookupField:upn, prefix:"u."
| fieldsAdd prompts = u.prompts
| fieldsAdd status = if(account_enabled == "false", "Disabled account", else: if(isNull(prompts), "No usage record", else: if(prompts == 0, "Zero prompts", else: "Prompting")))
| summarize a = countIf(status == "Prompting"), n = count()
| fields Adoption = if(n > 0, round(toDouble(a) / n * 100), else: 0)

8.query:
timeseries lic = max(m365copilot.user_licensed), by:{upn, user, department, account_enabled}, from: now()-2d
| fieldsAdd upn = lower(upn), licensed = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(lic))
| filterOut isNull(licensed)
| dedup upn
| lookup [
    timeseries p = max(m365copilot.user_prompts), by:{upn}, from: now()-3d
    | fieldsAdd upn = lower(upn), prompts = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(p))
    | summarize prompts = max(prompts), by:{upn}
  ], sourceField:upn, lookupField:upn, prefix:"u."
| fieldsAdd prompts = u.prompts
| fieldsAdd status = if(account_enabled == "false", "Disabled account", else: if(isNull(prompts), "No usage record", else: if(prompts == 0, "Zero prompts", else: "Prompting")))
| summarize Unused = countIf(status != "Prompting")

9.content:
**Unused licences**

assigned, not prompting in 28d · excl. unassigned seats

10.title: Licence utilisation
10.query:
timeseries lic = max(m365copilot.user_licensed), by:{upn, user, department, account_enabled}, from: now()-2d
| fieldsAdd upn = lower(upn), licensed = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(lic))
| filterOut isNull(licensed)

    timeseries p = max(m365copilot.user_prompts), by:{upn}, from: now()-3d

11.title: Licences vs activity
11.query: timeseries Purchased = sum(m365copilot.licences.purchased), Assigned = sum(m365copilot.licences.assigned), `Active (7d, any)` = max(m365copilot.active_users), interval: 1d

13.content:
## 💰 Estimated Value (AUD)
*Uses Microsoft's Copilot assisted hours / assisted value approach. Prompts × **MinutesPerPrompt** (filter, default 6) ÷ 60 = assisted hours; assisted hours × AUD 83/h = assisted value. **These are estimates, not measured time savings.***

14.query:
timeseries v = max(m365copilot.prompts_by_app), by:{app}, from: now()-3d
| fieldsAdd prompts = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(v))
| filterOut isNull(prompts)
| summarize total = sum(prompts)
| fields Prompts = total

16.query:
timeseries v = max(m365copilot.prompts_by_app), by:{app}, from: now()-3d
| fieldsAdd prompts = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(v))
| filterOut isNull(prompts)
| summarize total = sum(prompts)
| fields Hours = round(total * toDouble($MinutesPerPrompt) / 60, decimals: 0)

18.query:
timeseries v = max(m365copilot.prompts_by_app), by:{app}, from: now()-3d
| fieldsAdd prompts = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(v))
| filterOut isNull(prompts)
| summarize total = sum(prompts)
| fields Value = round(total * toDouble($MinutesPerPrompt) / 60 * 83, decimals: 0)

20.content:
**How this compares with Microsoft's figures**

- **Assisted hours**: Microsoft credits 6 min per Copilot action (the default here; lower it with the **MinutesPerPrompt** filter to test a conservative case) — [Copilot Dashboard metric definitions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/viva/insights/org-team-insights/copilot-dashboard), [research basis](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/worklab/work-trend-index/copilots-earliest-users-teach-us-about-generative-ai-at-work).
- **Assisted value**: assisted hours × hourly rate. Microsoft's default is US$72/h ([BLS](https://www.bls.gov/news.release/ecec.t04.htm)); this dashboard uses AUD 83/h.
- **Not included here**: meeting-recap hours, which Microsoft also counts. Expect these figures to be conservative.
- **More**: [How Microsoft measures AI value](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/worklab/how-we-measure-the-value-of-ai-at-work) · [Copilot impact report](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/viva/insights/advanced/analyst/templates/microsoft-365-copilot-impact)

21.content:
## 🧭 Adoption Journey
*Assigned licences grouped by 28d prompt count. Use the unused-licence list to drive enablement or reclaim licences.*

22.title: Corporate adoption journey (28d)
22.query:
timeseries lic = max(m365copilot.user_licensed), by:{upn, user, department, account_enabled}, from: now()-2d
| fieldsAdd upn = lower(upn), licensed = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(lic))
| filterOut isNull(licensed)
| dedup upn
| lookup [
    timeseries p = max(m365copilot.user_prompts), by:{upn}, from: now()-3d
    | fieldsAdd upn = lower(upn), prompts = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(p))
    | summarize prompts = max(prompts), by:{upn}
  ], sourceField:upn, lookupField:upn, prefix:"u."
| fieldsAdd prompts = u.prompts
| fieldsAdd status = if(account_enabled == "false", "Disabled account", else: if(isNull(prompts), "No usage record", else: if(prompts == 0, "Zero prompts", else: "Prompting")))
| fieldsAdd n = if(status == "Prompting", prompts, else: 0)
| fieldsAdd stage = if(n == 0, 1, else: if(n < 10, 2, else: if(n < 50, 3, else: if(n < 100, 4, else: 5))))
| summarize Users = count(), by:{stage}
| fieldsAdd Cohort = if(stage == 1, "Inactive (0 prompts)", else: if(stage == 2, "Exploring (1-9 prompts)", else: if(stage == 3, "Adopting (10-49 prompts)", else: if(stage == 4, "Embedded (50-99 prompts)", else: "Power Users (100+ prompts)"))))

29.content:
## 🏢 Departments
*Scorecard covers every department, with licence cost and unused spend at the selected **SeatPrice**. Use the **Department** filter at the top to drill into one or more.*

30.title: Department scorecard (28d)
30.query:
timeseries lic = max(m365copilot.user_licensed), by:{upn, user, department, account_enabled}, from: now()-2d
| fieldsAdd upn = lower(upn), licensed = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(lic))
| filterOut isNull(licensed)
| dedup upn
| lookup [
    timeseries p = max(m365copilot.user_prompts), by:{upn}, from: now()-3d
    | fieldsAdd upn = lower(upn), prompts = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(p))
    | summarize prompts = max(prompts), by:{upn}
  ], sourceField:upn, lookupField:upn, prefix:"u."
| fieldsAdd prompts = u.prompts
| fieldsAdd status = if(account_enabled == "false", "Disabled account", else: if(isNull(prompts), "No usage record", else: if(prompts == 0, "Zero prompts", else: "Prompting")))
| summarize Licensed = count(), Active = countIf(status == "Prompting"), Prompts = sum(if(isNull(prompts), 0, else: prompts)), by:{Department = department}
| fieldsAdd `Adoption %` = round(toDouble(Active) / Licensed * 100), `Prompts / User` = round(toDouble(Prompts) / Licensed, decimals: 1),
    `Value (AUD, 28d)` = round(Prompts * toDouble($MinutesPerPrompt) / 60 * 83), `Cost (AUD/mo)` = round(Licensed * toDouble($SeatPrice)), `Unused (AUD/mo)` = round((Licensed - Active) * toDouble($SeatPrice)),
    ROI = round((Prompts * toDouble($MinutesPerPrompt) / 60 * 83) / (Licensed * toDouble($SeatPrice) * 12 / 365 * 28), decimals: 1)
| sort `Unused (AUD/mo)` desc

51.content:
## 💳 Licence Cost (AUD)
*Seat price comes from the **SeatPrice** filter (AUD per user per month — set it to the contract price). **Unused** = every purchased seat not used for prompting in 28d: unassigned, zero prompts, no usage record or disabled account. 28d cost = monthly × 12 ÷ 365 × 28.*

52.title: Monthly licence spend
52.query:
timeseries pu = sum(m365copilot.licences.purchased), from: now()-2d
| fieldsAdd Purchased = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(pu)), k = 1
| fields Spend = round(Purchased * toDouble($SeatPrice))

53.title: Unused spend / month
53.query:
timeseries pu = sum(m365copilot.licences.purchased), from: now()-2d
| fieldsAdd Purchased = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(pu)), k = 1
| lookup [
timeseries lic = max(m365copilot.user_licensed), by:{upn, user, department, account_enabled}, from: now()-2d
| fieldsAdd upn = lower(upn), licensed = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(lic))
| filterOut isNull(licensed)
| dedup upn
| lookup [
    timeseries p = max(m365copilot.user_prompts), by:{upn}, from: now()-3d
    | fieldsAdd upn = lower(upn), prompts = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(p))
    | summarize prompts = max(prompts), by:{upn}
  ], sourceField:upn, lookupField:upn, prefix:"u."
| fieldsAdd prompts = u.prompts
| fieldsAdd status = if(account_enabled == "false", "Disabled account", else: if(isNull(prompts), "No usage record", else: if(prompts == 0, "Zero prompts", else: "Prompting")))
| summarize Prompting = countIf(status == "Prompting")
| fieldsAdd k = 1
], sourceField:k, lookupField:k, prefix:"r."
| fields Unused = round((Purchased - r.Prompting) * toDouble($SeatPrice))

54.title: Annual reclaim opportunity
54.query:
timeseries pu = sum(m365copilot.licences.purchased), from: now()-2d
| fieldsAdd Purchased = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(pu)), k = 1
| lookup [
timeseries lic = max(m365copilot.user_licensed), by:{upn, user, department, account_enabled}, from: now()-2d
| fieldsAdd upn = lower(upn), licensed = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(lic))
| filterOut isNull(licensed)
| dedup upn
| lookup [
    timeseries p = max(m365copilot.user_prompts), by:{upn}, from: now()-3d
    | fieldsAdd upn = lower(upn), prompts = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(p))
    | summarize prompts = max(prompts), by:{upn}
  ], sourceField:upn, lookupField:upn, prefix:"u."
| fieldsAdd prompts = u.prompts
| fieldsAdd status = if(account_enabled == "false", "Disabled account", else: if(isNull(prompts), "No usage record", else: if(prompts == 0, "Zero prompts", else: "Prompting")))
| summarize Prompting = countIf(status == "Prompting")
| fieldsAdd k = 1
], sourceField:k, lookupField:k, prefix:"r."
| fields Reclaim = round((Purchased - r.Prompting) * toDouble($SeatPrice) * 12)

| fieldsAdd Purchased = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(pu)), k = 1
| lookup [
timeseries lic = max(m365copilot.user_licensed), by:{upn, user, department, account_enabled}, from: now()-2d
| fieldsAdd upn = lower(upn), licensed = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(lic))

| fieldsAdd k = 1
], sourceField:k, lookupField:k, prefix:"r."
| fields PerUser = if(r.Prompting > 0, round(Purchased * toDouble($SeatPrice) / r.Prompting, decimals: 2), else: 0)

56.title: Cost per prompt (28d)
56.query:
timeseries pu = sum(m365copilot.licences.purchased), from: now()-2d
| fieldsAdd Purchased = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(pu)), k = 1

57.query:
timeseries pu = sum(m365copilot.licences.purchased), from: now()-2d
| fieldsAdd Purchased = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(pu)), k = 1
| lookup [
  timeseries v = max(m365copilot.prompts_by_app), by:{app}
  | fieldsAdd prompts = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(v))
  | summarize Prompts = sum(prompts)
  | fieldsAdd k = 1
], sourceField:k, lookupField:k, prefix:"q."
| fields ROI = if(Purchased > 0, round((q.Prompts * toDouble($MinutesPerPrompt) / 60 * 83) / (Purchased * toDouble($SeatPrice) * 12 / 365 * 28), decimals: 1), else: 0)

58.title: Licence cost by status
58.query:
timeseries lic = max(m365copilot.user_licensed), by:{upn, user, department, account_enabled}, from: now()-2d
| fieldsAdd upn = lower(upn), licensed = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(lic))
| filterOut isNull(licensed)
| dedup upn
| lookup [
    timeseries p = max(m365copilot.user_prompts), by:{upn}, from: now()-3d
    | fieldsAdd upn = lower(upn), prompts = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(p))
    | summarize prompts = max(prompts), by:{upn}
  ], sourceField:upn, lookupField:upn, prefix:"u."
| fieldsAdd prompts = u.prompts
| fieldsAdd status = if(account_enabled == "false", "Disabled account", else: if(isNull(prompts), "No usage record", else: if(prompts == 0, "Zero prompts", else: "Prompting")))
| summarize Seats = count(), by:{status}
| append [
  timeseries pu = sum(m365copilot.licences.purchased), asg = sum(m365copilot.licences.assigned), from: now()-2d
  | fields status = "Unassigned licence", Seats = toLong(arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(pu)) - arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(asg)))
]
| filter Seats > 0
| fields Status = status, Seats, `Monthly cost (AUD)` = round(Seats * toDouble($SeatPrice)), `Annual cost (AUD)` = round(Seats * toDouble($SeatPrice) * 12)
| sort Seats desc

59.content:
## 🧮 Definitions & Calculations
*How every number on this dashboard is worked out. The table on the right recalculates live from the same data, so each figure can be checked on screen.*

60.content:
**Definitions**

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **Purchased** | Copilot seats bought (Graph `subscribedSkus` → `prepaidUnits.enabled`) |
| **Assigned** | Seats assigned to a user (`consumedUnits`) |
| **Active** | Licensed user with ≥ 1 Copilot prompt in the last 28 days |
| **Unused** | Purchased seat not used for prompting in 28d — unassigned, zero prompts, no usage record, or disabled account |
| **Prompts** | Copilot prompts across all apps, trailing 28 days (Graph usage report) |
| **Assisted hours** | Prompts × **MinutesPerPrompt** ÷ 60 — Microsoft's default is 6 min |
| **Assisted value** | Assisted hours × AUD 83/h — *estimate, not measured* |
| **28-day cost** | Monthly spend pro-rated to the 28-day usage window |
| **Value ROI** | Assisted value ÷ 28-day cost — *estimate* |

*Cost uses **Purchased** seats, because you pay for every seat bought whether assigned or not. The Adoption Overview "Unused" tile counts assigned seats only; the cost figures include unassigned seats too.*

61.title: Worked calculations — live, follows the SeatPrice and MinutesPerPrompt filters
61.query:
timeseries pu = sum(m365copilot.licences.purchased), asg = sum(m365copilot.licences.assigned), from: now()-2d
| fieldsAdd Purchased = toLong(arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(pu))), Assigned = toLong(arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(asg))), k = 1
| lookup [
timeseries lic = max(m365copilot.user_licensed), by:{upn, user, department, account_enabled}, from: now()-2d
| fieldsAdd upn = lower(upn), licensed = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(lic))
| filterOut isNull(licensed)
| dedup upn
| lookup [
    timeseries p = max(m365copilot.user_prompts), by:{upn}, from: now()-3d
    | fieldsAdd upn = lower(upn), prompts = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(p))
    | summarize prompts = max(prompts), by:{upn}
  ], sourceField:upn, lookupField:upn, prefix:"u."
| fieldsAdd prompts = u.prompts
| fieldsAdd status = if(account_enabled == "false", "Disabled account", else: if(isNull(prompts), "No usage record", else: if(prompts == 0, "Zero prompts", else: "Prompting")))
| summarize Active = countIf(status == "Prompting"), Licensed = count()
| fieldsAdd k = 1
], sourceField:k, lookupField:k, prefix:"r."
| lookup [
  timeseries v = max(m365copilot.prompts_by_app), by:{app}, from: now()-3d
  | fieldsAdd prompts = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(v))
  | summarize Prompts = sum(prompts)
  | fieldsAdd k = 1
], sourceField:k, lookupField:k, prefix:"q."
| fieldsAdd Active = r.Active, Licensed = r.Licensed, Prompts = toLong(q.Prompts), price = toDouble($SeatPrice)
| fieldsAdd Unused = Purchased - Active, Monthly = Purchased * price
| fieldsAdd Cost28 = Monthly * 12 / 365 * 28, Hours = Prompts * toDouble($MinutesPerPrompt) / 60
| fieldsAdd Value = Hours * 83
| fieldsAdd rows = array(
    record(Step = 1, Metric = "Purchased seats", Formula = "Graph /subscribedSkus prepaidUnits.enabled", Calculation = "—", Result = toString(Purchased)),
    record(Step = 2, Metric = "Assigned seats", Formula = "Graph /subscribedSkus consumedUnits", Calculation = "—", Result = toString(Assigned)),
    record(Step = 3, Metric = "Active users", Formula = "Licensed users with ≥1 prompt in 28d", Calculation = "—", Result = toString(Active)),
    record(Step = 4, Metric = "Unused seats", Formula = "Purchased − Active", Calculation = concat(toString(Purchased), " − ", toString(Active)), Result = toString(Unused)),
    record(Step = 5, Metric = "  of which unassigned", Formula = "Purchased − Assigned", Calculation = concat(toString(Purchased), " − ", toString(Assigned)), Result = toString(Purchased - Assigned)),
    record(Step = 6, Metric = "Adoption", Formula = "Active ÷ licensed users", Calculation = concat(toString(Active), " ÷ ", toString(Licensed)), Result = concat(toString(round(toDouble(Active) / Licensed * 100)), "%")),
    record(Step = 7, Metric = "Monthly spend", Formula = "Purchased × SeatPrice", Calculation = concat(toString(Purchased), " × A$", toString($SeatPrice)), Result = concat("A$", toString(toLong(round(Monthly))))),
    record(Step = 8, Metric = "Unused spend / month", Formula = "Unused × SeatPrice", Calculation = concat(toString(Unused), " × A$", toString($SeatPrice)), Result = concat("A$", toString(toLong(round(Unused * price))))),
    record(Step = 9, Metric = "Annual reclaim", Formula = "Unused spend × 12", Calculation = concat(concat("A$", toString(toLong(round(Unused * price)))), " × 12"), Result = concat("A$", toString(toLong(round(Unused * price * 12))))),
    record(Step = 10, Metric = "Cost per active user", Formula = "Monthly spend ÷ Active", Calculation = concat(concat("A$", toString(toLong(round(Monthly)))), " ÷ ", toString(Active)), Result = concat("A$", toString(round(Monthly / Active, decimals: 2)))),
    record(Step = 11, Metric = "28-day cost", Formula = "Monthly × 12 ÷ 365 × 28", Calculation = concat(concat("A$", toString(toLong(round(Monthly)))), " × 12 ÷ 365 × 28"), Result = concat("A$", toString(toLong(round(Cost28))))),
    record(Step = 12, Metric = "Prompts (28d)", Formula = "Sum of prompts across all Copilot apps", Calculation = "—", Result = toString(Prompts)),
    record(Step = 13, Metric = "Assisted hours", Formula = "Prompts × MinutesPerPrompt ÷ 60", Calculation = concat(toString(Prompts), " × ", toString($MinutesPerPrompt), " ÷ 60"), Result = toString(toLong(round(Hours)))),
    record(Step = 14, Metric = "Assisted value (est.)", Formula = "Assisted hours × A$83", Calculation = concat(toString(toLong(round(Hours))), " × A$83"), Result = concat("A$", toString(toLong(round(Value))))),
    record(Step = 15, Metric = "Cost per prompt", Formula = "28-day cost ÷ Prompts", Calculation = concat(concat("A$", toString(toLong(round(Cost28)))), " ÷ ", toString(Prompts)), Result = concat("A$", toString(round(Cost28 / Prompts, decimals: 2)))),
    record(Step = 16, Metric = "Value ROI (est.)", Formula = "Assisted value ÷ 28-day cost", Calculation = concat(concat("A$", toString(toLong(round(Value)))), " ÷ ", concat("A$", toString(toLong(round(Cost28))))), Result = concat(toString(round(Value / Cost28, decimals: 1)), "×")))
| expand rows
| fields `#` = rows[Step], Metric = rows[Metric], Formula = rows[Formula], Calculation = rows[Calculation], Result = rows[Result]
